headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. Emphasize weight contrast (e.g., Light and ExtraBold side-by-side).

body.usage: Use for body text, forms, tables, and dashboards.

colors.theme: Dark/Light Toggle - The Performance Pro Archetype
rules: Use primary color (Blaze/Volt) sparingly for CTA, badges, and progress bars.
Never use pure black or pure white. Tint grays slightly.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers/navs: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), saturate-150, 1px subtle inner border.
visual enhancers.neumorphism: Do not use. Stick to flat cards with 1px borders.
visual enhancers.textures: Apply subtle SVG noise/grain over the marketing landing page hero.
visual enhancers.borders: Cardless or max 8px border-radius (rounded-md). Sharp, tactical aesthetic.

grids.marketing: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical col-spans (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12), gap-8 to gap-12. Do not fill all cells perfectly, leave negative space.
grids.dashboard: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full for stretching.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-align most content. Optical alignment over geometric.
layouts.dashboard: Sidebar nav (collapsible) + top header (glass). Content area dense and functional.

motion.hover: Hover states must lighten primary colors, lift cards (-translate-y-1), and add subtle shadow.
motion.framer_motion: Use for staggered list entrances, accordion expansions, and dialog appearances.

accessibility.contrast: APCA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large/interactive.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for Duotone/bold weight, high-end feel.
media.images: Use max-h-[80vh] on mobile to prevent blocking content. Apply bg-black/40 overlay on hero images if text is overlaid.

3d libraries and steps.usage: Use ONLY on the marketing landing page (hero background or product abstraction). Dashboards must be 2D and performant.

hero_marketing.description: Modern construction worker using tablet - great for hero background or main feature.

foreman_avatar.description: Construction worker in hard hat for avatar/profile placeholder.

equipment.description: Yellow heavy excavator - use in Equipment Management dashboard.

vehicles.description: Red semi truck - use in Vehicles Management dashboard.

estimates.description: Architectural blueprints - use for Estimates Builder visual context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement light/dark mode toggle using standard Tailwind classes (dark: class).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize borders (max rounded-md) and spacing.
Marketing Landing Page must be pure HTML/Tailwind, avoiding generic Shadcn card wrappers.
For Datepicker use Shadcn, NOT native <input type='date'>.
For Dashboards, ensure strict bento grid layouts without jagged bottoms.
Never center text universally, stick to left-aligned for data/dashboards.
Build the 3 Dashboards (Owner, Foreman, Employee) carefully factoring role-based access.
Delete App.css text-align: center if it exists.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, on-distribution UI slop. Produce high-end, tactile, deeply stylized designs.
Dark colors look good independently. NO dark color gradients.
Create depth via z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp button styles with hover state changes.
Never use emoji characters as icons.
Use 2-3x more padding/spacing than standard Bootstrap/Tailwind tutorials.
Implement micro-animations on all interactive states.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Never use placeholder image domains (via.placeholder.com). ALWAYS use provided image_urls.
For JS files, follow React/JSX conventions.
You have .js and .jsx files. Write components and code matching standard JSX functional component definitions.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Hierarchy over decoration: let typography and spacing define structure, not excessive borders or gradients.
Provide clear system feedback for all actions using toast notifications (e.g., via sonner).
Opt for optical alignment vs geometric alignment where visual balance feels off.
Support a frictionless mobile experience: target minimum 44x44px hit zones for touch actions.
Emphasize the primary task of the view, demoting secondary actions into dropdown menus or muted button styles.
